findings.evidence: Lines 154–162 define `AmbientGroup` as `SpStd.points` while explicitly disclaiming the L0 identification. The roadmap README lines 211–214 makes L1 depend on L0 and L3 depend on L1/L2, and lines 259–303 explicitly reject classical matrix carriers as a fallback because they leave the uniform pinned route.
findings.fix: First construct the Layer 9 pinned type-C Chevalley–Demazure carrier or prove the required carrier identification and transport the Frobenius/root subgroups through it; defer `steinberg` and `Group` until then.
findings.issue: `Group := FixedPointCandidate d.steinberg` runs L3 on `SpStd.points`, although no identification with the pinned simply connected type-C group exists; this changes the ambient object defining the candidate and bypasses L0, a required prerequisite.

summary: The proposed `TypeCLieIndex.Group` substitutes an unverified standard matrix carrier for the required pinned Chevalley–Demazure group, so it is not the L3 candidate it claims to assemble.
